verdict.rationale: Invoicing is a fair question for a finance platform, but the evidence only documents accounts payable: receiving vendor invoices, matching them to POs, approving them and paying vendors. Nothing shows Ramp creating or sending branded customer invoices or collecting incoming payments on them. AP bill pay is a different capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can create and send branded invoices with built-in payment collection
